headline: Jack Attack strikes the vein; Aeil loses the week by 2.36
lede: Wild week in the territory, pardner. Jack Attack hauled 144.4 out of the creek while the Warthogs came back to camp with 69.73 in the pan, and down at the other end of the trail Scott's Hype squeaked past Aeil by 2.36. With 6 weeks left before the regular season closes and 8 seats at the playoff table, every ounce counts.
paragraphs: Jack Attack ran 144.4 straight over the Super Troopers and left them at 85.16, the widest margin of the week at 59.24. Tony Pollard did the heavy haulin' with 36.95 and Blake Cashman added the week's best defensive day at 20.0, which more than covered Will Anderson Jr. mumblin' in with 2.5. Super Troopers got 21.0 from the Bengals defense, got a clean 0.0 out of Jaleel McLaughlin, and left Kyler Murray and his 13.55 sittin' on the bench; both wagons now sit at 4-3, but only one's lost 3 in a row.

Long Howie posted 127.76 and barely left a nickel behind, 0.85 on the bench and 0.0 a better lineup would have added, which is about as tidy as a camp gets. Jared Goff led the way with 24.21. Norskes U Betcha managed 72.26 despite Tyler Shough's 19.91, mostly because the Eagles defense dug a hole worth -4.0 and Dameon Pierce watched 11.6 go by from the bench; that's 2-5 and 2 straight losses.

Jrod put up 116.97 and sent the Warthogs home with 69.73, the lowest score in the whole territory this week. Drake Maye went for 33.72, and Jrod still had Caleb Williams and his 27.66 ridin' in the wagon bed, worth 14.6 more in a better lineup. The Warthogs got 23.75 from Javonte Williams, a flat 0.0 from the 49ers defense, and left the Bears defense and its 10.0 benched; 5-2 still looks fine on paper, pardner, but that was a rough day at the claim.

e-mans revenge made it 4 wins in a row, 124.7 to 87.37 over Justin's Bad Team, with Matthew Stafford leadin' at 22.35 and nothing left on the bench worth takin' back. A.J. Brown's 3.6 was the only soft spot and it never mattered. Justin's Bad Team got 14.27 from Tanner McKee, 1.1 from Nico Collins, and left 13.2 in better lineup money on the table with Kyle Pitts Sr. and his 9.1 watchin'.

WeBleedOrangeAndBlue won its 5th straight, 133.09 to 97.14 over sisu, with Joe Burrow throwin' up 31.04. Funny thing: that's also the week's worst lineup, 18.85 a better set would have added, with Luther Burden III and 19.65 parked on the bench next to Jalen Coker's 0.85 in the starting slot. sisu got 19.24 from Jacoby Brissett and left Bo Nix and his 23.74 in the wagon, though only 5.75 of it was really gettable.

HAWKSRULE edged Zihuatanejo 110.74 to 101.14, a margin of 9.6. Dak Prescott carried the load at 23.64, and Emeka Egbuka's clean 0.0 didn't cost the outfit a thing since a better lineup was only worth 1.65. Zihuatanejo ran a flawless camp, 0.0 left behind, got 17.95 from Emanuel Wilson, and still came up short; both sides now sit at 3-4.

Dart Star Orchestra took one by 4.75, 114.91 to 110.16 over densmen. Deshaun Watson led with 24.51, and the winners left 13.3 of better lineup on the table with Blake Corum's 15.85 benched, which could have been an awful story. densmen got 18.26 from C.J. Stroud while Geno Smith sat with 26.94, and that's 5 losses in a row at 1-6.

Closest race in the territory: Scott's Hype 117.46, Aeil 115.10, decided by 2.36. Michael Penix Jr. went for 26.41 for Scott's Hype, Kirk Cousins answered with 22.6 for Aeil, and both outfits ran clean lineups with 0.0 left to gain. When neither fella misplays a card and it still comes down to 2.36, that's just the trail bein' the trail.
sign_off: Stat man says Aeil's James Cook III leads all 34 qualifiers in Explosive Run Rate at 9% of carries, and it still didn't cover a 2.36 shortfall. 6 weeks to go, 8 spots open: set your lineups like the silver's real, because it is.
purse: The commissioner's strongbox opens for 4 this week: Jack Attack takes $40 on 144.4, WeBleedOrangeAndBlue takes $20 on 133.09, Long Howie takes $10 on 127.76, and e-mans revenge takes $5 on 124.7. That's 2 weeks in the money for Jack Attack, 4 for WeBleedOrangeAndBlue, 2 for Long Howie, and 3 for e-mans revenge.
